snippet.title: Smawverse Demo Trailer | Dark Fantasy Bullet Heaven, Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
The Smawverse demo is out now on Steam. Play it free: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4640450

Smawverse is a dark fantasy bullet heaven where your weapons fight for you. You are a stray cat reforged in iron, carving through the undead wreck of a kingdom that fell to its own keeper. Built in Unreal Engine 5.

In the demo:
- Four prophets to pray to: fire, frost, plague and lightning
- Combine two prophets to unlock spells neither has alone
- Streets that never repeat, a new city every run
- Summon the boss and beat him to transform your power
- Four weapons, a hideout that restores between runs, leaderboards across four difficulties

Wishlist the full game and play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4640450

#Smawverse #indiegame #bullethaven #roguelite #darkfantasy #survivorlike #steamdemo #unrealengine5
